title: Wayanchor
text: Sustain the chunk containing the anchor for 16 Pulse each second. A 2,400-Pulse reserve bridges interruptions; nearby generators refill it. The anchor holds one chunk, not a radius. Up to 32 anchors may run per dimension. Redstone or an empty reserve releases its ticket. Removing the block releases it immediately. Place another anchor at a distant relay endpoint if that endpoint must keep working while you travel.

title: Hush Totem
text: A quiet circle suppresses hostile spawning within 24 blocks for 8 Pulse per second. It covers natural and spawner-born hostiles, including Summoning Cradles. It does not remove existing mobs, stop animals, or override commands and spawn eggs. Redstone silences the ward immediately. Keep a cradle outside the circle, or use redstone to alternate between peace and summoning.

title: Grove Tender
text: Place the tender at crop height in the middle of a 9-by-9 bed. Supply seeds in the top inventory row and extract harvests below. It plants for 4 Pulse or harvests and replants one ripe crop for 12 Pulse, reserving one seed before storing the drops. At most one crop is worked each second. Full output preserves the crop. Vanilla and compatible CropBlock crops work; trees, cocoa, sugar cane and custom machines are outside its scope. Player protection events apply. Redstone pauses work and inventory access.

title: Binding Effigy
text: An empty or exhausted effigy remembers a living spirit without harming it. Sneak-use it on an eligible animal or hostile creature. Common farm animals, zombies, skeletons, spiders, creepers and the thirteen Tribal Power creatures can be imprinted; bosses cannot. A live binding cannot be overwritten. An imprint alone has no summons: awaken it through the Three-voice Binding.

title: Three-voice Binding
text: Seat a Spirit Seal in a Ritual Brazier. Place Earth, Air and Spirit Totems within eight blocks. Supply 200 nearby Pulse and carry three Spiritweave. Use your imprinted, exhausted effigy on the brazier with redstone off. The three voices knot 512 summoning threads into it. Renew an exhausted effigy the same way, or first imprint another eligible spirit. The recipe is deliberately a ritual, not a spawn-egg shortcut.

title: Summoning Cradle
text: Place a bound effigy in the first slot and Spiritweave in the second. Every ten seconds, the cradle attempts one summon on a clear, dry floor within three blocks. A successful summon costs 80 Pulse, one Spiritweave and one bound thread. Eight nearby mobs within twelve blocks pause it. Hostiles cannot be called in Peaceful or inside a Hush ward. Failed or blocked attempts spend nothing. The effigy tooltip shows remaining uses; a comparator reads them. Redstone pauses everything. Bottom automation can retrieve an exhausted effigy for renewal. Picking up the cradle drops the same effigy with its remaining count intact.

title: Spirit Lantern
text: A carved copper-and-wood lantern brightens the camp at light level 15 without fuel. Redstone dims it; a comparator reports whether it is lit. Its animated crystal shares the living-lattice palette. Use lanterns to mark safe paths between workshops.

title: Rain Chime
text: Hang the idea of rain in copper. The chime sounds softly every ten seconds during rain; a comparator reads 8 for rain and 15 for thunder, or zero for clear skies. Redstone mutes it and sets its output to zero. Use the weather signal to choreograph Ley collection and camp lights. No fuel is needed.

title: Offering Table
text: A low carved display table doubles as a 27-slot store. Hoppers and item pipes can insert or extract from every side. A comparator reads fullness. Redstone locks both the menu and automation, so the same decorative table can become a controlled offering buffer beside a cradle. No Pulse is needed for storage.
